newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aristocrat confident on yr forecast.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aristocrat confident on yr forecast.

text.p: Gaming machine maker Aristocrat Leisure Ltd sad on Thursday it remained confident of achieving its profit forecast for the year to June 30, 1997 contained in its prospectus.

"For the current year, and based on the first quarter results and the present trends of trading, directors remain confident that the full year forecast contained in the propectus is achievable," chairman Allan McDonald told the annual general meeting.
Aristocrat forecast earnings before tax and abnormals of A$32.8 million for the 1996/97 year.
It reported an operating profit of A$24.08 million in 1995/96, above the prospectus forecast of A$23.7 million.
Aristocrat listed on the Australian Stock Exchange in July 1996.
It said in its prospectus it expected sales of A$321 million in 1996/97 from actual sales of A$256.92 million in 1995/96.
